# Control sweep (main): every checkbox and spinner of the Options, Audio, Advanced and Realism pages clicked once
# Generated by scripts/gen-controls-tours.py from tour_options_main.txt. CHANGES SETTINGS in the running game (the profile is written on exit):
# run only through scripts/gtr2-control-check.py, which launches the game for this tour alone, compares the profile and reverts it.
# Needs:  gtr2-nav.py path --setting-step FILE
# Format: PAGE | LABEL | EXPECTED PAGE   ('!CONTROLS' clicks every control of the page shown)
MAIN MENU | OPTIONS | OPTIONS_BASIC_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_BASIC_SIMMAIN | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_BASIC_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_BASIC_SIMMAIN | VIDEO | OPTIONS_DETAIL_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_DETAIL_SIMMAIN | AUDIO | OPTIONS_AUDIO_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_AUDIO_SIMMAIN | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_AUDIO_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_AUDIO_SIMMAIN | ADVANCED | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SIMMAIN | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_SIMMAIN | REALISM | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SIMMAIN | !CONTROLS | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SIMMAIN
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_SIMMAIN | CONTROLS | CONTROL_KEYS_SIMMAIN
CONTROL_KEYS_SIMMAIN | ADVANCED | CONTROL_ONE_SIMMAIN
CONTROL_ONE_SIMMAIN | FORCE | CONTROL_FORCE_SIMMAIN
CONTROL_FORCE_SIMMAIN | MAIN MENU | MAIN MENU
